page_title: RSO 1-3 VIL | Real Sociedad v Villarreal 23/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
90+8' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
90+5' 1 - 3 It's 1:3! Goncalo Guedes feeds Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
90+4' Real Sociedad enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
88' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
86' 1 - 2 Goal! Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
84' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) replaces Francis Coquelin.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Alex Baena cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
81' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
81' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
80' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad). Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
79' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) on for Gerard Moreno.
79' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
77' Alex Baena (Villarreal) commits a foul during an attacking move.
76' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.
72' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' Substitution. Arsen Zakharyan will be replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
72' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
71' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
70' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Parejo (Villarreal) replacing Ilias Akhomach.
70' That will be all from Alberto Moreno who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal).
68' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had an easy-decision to make.

66' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is replacing Andre Silva.
64' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Brais Mendez and he is replaced by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad).

64' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
64' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
63' The game has begun to heat up. Raul Albiol (Villarreal) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
62' The game is interrupted. Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
62' Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
60' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Real Sociedad as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

60' There's a break in play and referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Sociedad using VAR. This could be interesting!
59' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
58' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
57' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

56' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

55' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
53' The attendance for today's match is 30609.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Javier Iglesias Villanueva didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
49' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.
49' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Real Sociedad get a corner.
47' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Alex Baena plays it into the box, and Santi Comesana (Villarreal) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 0:2.
46' Half-time substitution. Imanol Alguacil decided to make a change. Hamari Traore is replaced by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) tried his luck from a long-range free kick, but the effort came back off the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
45+1' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

41' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
41' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

40' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders. Real Sociedad force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

37' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
37' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
36' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
34' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Alex Baena (Villarreal) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
31' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
28' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 72:28.
26' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
24' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

23' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
19' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Santi Comesana (Villarreal) goes wild in celebration.
18' The Villarreal players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Raul Albiol finds Santi Comesana (Villarreal) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 0:1.
17' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.

17' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alex Remiro. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
14' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net.
14' Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.

13' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
13' The cross into the penalty area from Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
11' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
10' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows the whistle, Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul. Villarreal are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
7' Ander Barrenetxea is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
7' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
6' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
5' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
3' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
